coverage_notes: Supplementary Food Line recall watch only; production nationwide collector remains authoritative.
Completed exactly 12 targeted fresh web searches (4 grocery, 4 emergency distribution, 2 pantry/food bank, 2 official SNAP/WIC/assistance outage); no search-level failures.
No newly announced or newly effective U.S. disruptions in the eligible classes were substantiated within the bounded observation window.

Eastport ME only-grocery closure and Akron OH grocery fire were previously reported events outside the observation period, excluded as old. Canadian grocery store fire reports were excluded as non-U.S.
A national October 25 article discusses longer-running SNAP enrollment/policy changes, not a newly official immediate outage since the prior check; excluded.
Search indexes surfaced stale, unrelated, promotional and general storm coverage; search result crawl times were not interpreted as publication/incident times.
Excluded resource guides, donation appeals, generic food-cost articles, program promotion, opinions, duplicates, and unverified timestamps.
Zero findings means none verified by this bounded recall, not proof of absence nationwide.
No approval, publishing, automation schedule change, disabling, or change to primary collector was made.
